nl: Which files call the function low_stock? Do not count the file that only defines it. List relative paths.
oracle_program: code.symbols "low_stock" path: ["."] kind: function |> code.references include_definition: false
reference_bash: grep -rlE '(^|[^A-Za-z_])low_stock\(' . | sort | while read -r f; do grep -E '(^|[^A-Za-z_])low_stock\(' "$f" | grep -vqE '(def|func|function) low_stock\(' && echo "$f"; done
